chunks: ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ narrated from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Maslamah, from al-Sarrī ibn Khālid, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Shall I not inform you of the worst of people?”
They said, “Yes, O Messenger of Allah.”
He said: “The one who travels alone, withholds his aid, and strikes his servant.”

key_terms.رِفْدَهُ: his aid or assistance given to others

ai.seo_question: Who are described as the worst of people in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a moral teaching from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم about blameworthy traits. It condemns isolation in travel, withholding assistance from others, and harsh treatment of one's servant as signs of the worst kind of character.
